title: The factorial separation conjecture
summary: We propose the Factorial Separation Conjecture (FSC), a strict strengthening of earlier factorial gap conjectures: \[ |n!-m^k|>n \] for all integers $n\ge8$ and $m,k\ge2$. The inequality excludes every displacement up to and including the factorial index. We prove the conjecture unconditionally for exponents divisible by three, for even exponents at least four, and for every exponent at least two when the largest prime divisor of the base is at most $n+2$.
